# Cross Ratio observer fixtures

BSD-3-Clause; Copyright (c) 2026 CrispStrobe.

The original model and program remain under
`overlay/scratch-gui/static/sim-lab/`; their immutable SHA-256 digests are in
`contract.json`. Preserve `static/sim-lab/licenses/cross-ratio.txt` and the stock
LDraw component notices. No third-party part drawings are copied into this fixture.

`analytic.mjs` generates explicit analytic controls from circle intersections.
It is not a physics recording and never establishes candidate qualification.
The physical control removes one P axle from the original input at test time;
no production source is modified. Bounds were fixed before engine observation.
